title: Signature hypothesis is narrated as an observation; follow-on observer roles are also confused.

observed.input: proceduralState=CANDIDATE; first=flood at 1000 ms; followOn=null; no drone observation in limitations.
observed.actualHeadline: Flood followed by an unqualified drone observation in a simulation.
observed.expected: Describe the supplied flood candidate. Explicitly say no follow-on observation is provided. Never populate a missing stage from the signature name.

observed.input: Flood at 1000 ms, then a drone observation at 61000 ms; distinct simulated producers; gaps in coverage.
observed.actualSignificance: The sequence supports the hypothesis that a flood occurred and was later observed by a drone in the same simulation; neither event is established outside the exercise.
observed.expected: A drone was observed 60 seconds after the flood signal. Do not make the drone an observer or assert cause, coordination, identity or intent.

hashBoundCases.finding: Invents a drone follow-on despite followOn=null.
Reverses the observer role: says the flood was observed by a drone; evidence supplies a drone observation, not a drone acting as observer. Omits the supplied 60-second gap.

reproduce.requirements: Diagnostic app with the recorded model SHA cached; matching Android instrumentation APK. Runs fictional observations through production signature matching and actual offline inference.
reproduce.command: adb -s <authorized-phone> shell am instrument -w -e signatureAiSimulation true com.projectrevivesolutions.layerscope.diag.test/com.projectrevivesolutions.layertime.controller.BuilderSmokeInstrumentation

excludedRun: The initial run leaked later-stage drone context into first-stage limitations. It is preserved separately and excluded from model-only accuracy attribution. Corrected inputs reproduce the defect.
causeStatus: Observed semantic model failure under the corrected input. Training-data, prompt and weight contributions are not isolated; no hardware or ontology root cause is established.
containment: Normal model qualification remains closed; simulation directly invokes the unqualified development provider only. No live warnings or Hunter commands.
fixAcceptance: No invented follow-on when a signature names later stages but followOn is null.
Preserve observed entities, observer roles, event order, measured gaps and uncertainty.
Distinguish missing evidence from negative evidence and a hypothesis from an observation.
Pass held-out variations with unfamiliar names and event combinations, partial sequences, benign lookalikes and contradictory evidence.
Retain passes on the existing unchanged frozen acceptance suite; no weakening or training on held-out evaluation answers.
Verify the resulting quantized weights on supported phones; schema validity, a prompt-only workaround or output suppression alone does not establish a model fix.
qualificationScope: Two authored simulation cases with agent review; not field accuracy or independent expert validation.
currentRunnerNote: Current runner excludes simulation labels from model-visible input. Original labeled payloads and their exact hashes remain preserved; the current regression is an unlabeled variant, not a replacement of original evidence.
